newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Israel's ZAG a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Israel's ZAG a buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers initiated coverage of ZAG Industries Ltd, rating it a buy in a report released on Sunday.
Analyst Harriet Baldwin said she had upgraded her forecast for the company's earnings per share due to its strong 1996 performance and lower tax rates.
"ZAG's tax bill will be significantly lower than we have been assuming," the report said, citing government tax benefits extended to several of ZAG's Israeli subsidiaries.
Lehman said earnings per share were expected to reach $1.17 in 1997 and $1.80 in 1988, up from $1.01 and $1.30.
ZAG makes and sells consumer products made primarily of molded plastic. It has a line of about 60 products and expects to roll out another 30 new products this year.
